overloads.semanticRole: Serializes an email object into MIME text, following the JMAP specification, optionally overriding the header/body charset and encoding via options.

constraints: If options is omitted, the 'mail mode UTF8' charset/encoding configuration (US-ASCII if possible, otherwise UTF-8 & Quoted-printable) is used for both header and body parts.

Reference lifecycle (implied convention, not syntactically enforced): Mail message building: MAIL New attachment creates attachment objects to add into an Email object's attachments collection -> MAIL Convert to MIME serializes the completed email object to MIME text (used internally by SMTP_transporter.send()) -> MAIL Convert from MIME parses an inbound MIME document back into an email object.
